# DocSpread { #dyf.DocSpread }

```python
DocSpread(n_chunks, n_buckets, concentration, bucket_distribution)
```

Per-document chunk distribution across LSH buckets.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name                | Type             | Description                                                                     |
|---------------------|------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| n_chunks            | [int](`int`)     | Total chunks for this document.                                                 |
| n_buckets           | [int](`int`)     | Distinct buckets touched by chunks.                                             |
| concentration       | [float](`float`) | n_chunks / n_buckets ratio. High = topically focused, low = multi-topic bridge. |
| bucket_distribution | [dict](`dict`)   | Mapping of bucket_id to chunk count.                                            |
